name: ProcessEmailMessagesInOutlook
label: Process Email Messages in Outlook
description: Moves or deletes a collection of email messages in Outlook.

fields.name: OutlookApplication
fields.label: Outlook Application
fields.description: The Outlook Application object used to process messages.

fields.name: EmailMessages
fields.label: Email Messages
fields.description: The list of email messages to be processed (e.g., moved or deleted).

fields.name: ActionType
fields.label: Action Type
fields.description: Select whether to move or delete the selected email messages.

fields.name: TargetFolder
fields.label: Target Folder
fields.description: If action is 'Move', specify the target folder (Inbox, Sent, Junk, Outbox).
